value.rationale: First count desynchronization is the natural entrance boundary for rank/ballot competition among parallel collectors. The theorem resolves a family-wide finite-size bias and the first genuinely multi-player rare double-laggard channel; it identifies the singular two-versus-three collector boundary with quantitative constants, useful for initializing subsequent non-synchronized dynamics. The target quantities are not final completion times and are not determined by the previously known two-player Rayleigh limit.
